formulas.tex:
\begin{aligned}
\term{objective}{\ell(\rho)}&=-\frac n2\ln\frac{\term{sumOfSquares}{\mathrm{SSR}(\rho)}}{n}+\term{logDeterminant}{\ln|I-\rho W|}\\
\mathrm{SSR}(\rho)&=e_0^\top e_0-2\rho\,e_0^\top e_1+\rho^2e_1^\top e_1,
&\ln|I-\rho W|&=-\sum_{q=1}^{Q}\frac{(\rho s)^q}{q}\operatorname{tr}\!\big((W/s)^q\big)\\
\term{rho}{\hat\rho}&=\arg\max_{|\rho|\le B}\ \ell(\rho),
&\hat\beta&=\hat\beta_0-\hat\rho\,\hat\beta_1
\end{aligned}
formulas.ascii: Spatial lag model y = rho W y + X b + e (spreg ML_Lag, exact log-determinant replaced by a truncated trace series). e0, e1 are the OLS residuals of y and W y on [1, X]; SSR(rho) = e0'e0 - 2 rho e0'e1 + rho^2 e1'e1; concentrated log-likelihood l(rho) = -(n/2) ln(SSR(rho)/n) + ln|I - rho W| with ln|I - rho W| = -sum_{q=1..Q} (rho s)^q tr((W/s)^q)/q (Horner). rho = global maximum on [-B, B], B = min(0.99, series limit)/||W||_inf: analytic derivative on 1025 grid points, sign changes refined by 32 bisection steps. b = b0 - rho b1; sigma2 = SSR/n; variance = inverse information matrix of (b, rho, sigma2).
